name: po-o10
prompt:
In server/src/overview.rs, replace the body `todo!("unit o10")` of fn where_part with the real code. Keep its signature and doc comment exactly. Spec: returns json!({ "machine": ..., "folder": p.repo_folder, "git": ..., "gitState": ... }).
- No p.repo_machine_id: machine null, git null, gitState "none".
- Otherwise read `SELECT id, name, last_seen FROM machines WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?` (Option<(String, String, Option<String>)>; map a sqlx error to Err(e.to_string())). Not found: machine null, git null, gitState "none". Found: online = last_seen is within the last 90 seconds; compute it in SQL instead: select `last_seen IS NOT NULL AND (julianday('now') - julianday(last_seen)) * 86400 <= 90` as a bool column `online`, so the row is (String, String, bool). machine = {"id", "name", "online", "os": s.host.os(&id)}.
- git: parse p.repo_git as serde_json::Value; a non-object (empty text, bad JSON) means no cache (git null).
- stale = no cache, or the cache's "at" is older than GIT_STALE_MINUTES: compare the at string with util::minutes_ago(GIT_STALE_MINUTES) (RFC 3339 strings compare in time order).
- gitState: when online and stale and p.repo_folder is Some: spawn the read with tokio::spawn(refresh_git(s.clone(), user_id.to_string(), p.id.clone(), machine id, folder)) and say "reading" (git keeps the old cache, or null). Else when a cache exists: "known". Else "unknown".
Change nothing else in the file; the other functions keep their todo!() until their own job.
